description: The file contains unit tests for the MenuSessionsInjector component related to menu item insertion and injection of session and usage data within a macOS application. It tests how menu items are dynamically injected, ordered, and verifies the behavior with mock data.

methods.name: anchorsDynamicRowsBelowControlsAndActions
methods.description: Tests that the injector correctly finds the insert index for dynamic session rows.

methods.name: injectsDisconnectedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that the injector correctly injects a disabled or disconnected message when the control channel is not connected.

methods.name: injectsSessionRows
methods.description: Tests the injection of session rows and asserts the correct positioning of injected menu items.

methods.name: cost usage submenu does not use injector delegate
methods.description: Ensures that the cost usage submenu does not inadvertently use the injector delegate and correctly displays cost information.
